topics.title: Learning With Errors (LWE) & Module Lattice Foundations
topics.objective: Understand the hardness of the Shortest Vector Problem (SVP) and Ring/Module Learning With Errors (M-LWE).
topics.exercise: Formulate a toy polynomial ring quotient R_q = Z_q[X] / (X^n + 1) and demonstrate noise tolerance in message decryption.

topics.title: FIPS 203: ML-KEM (CRYSTALS-Kyber) Key Encapsulation
topics.objective: Implement public key generation, encapsulation, and decapsulation for post-quantum key establishment.
topics.exercise: Build an end-to-end TLS key exchange handshake embedding an ML-KEM-768 ciphertext alongside classic ECDH keys.

topics.title: FIPS 204: ML-DSA (CRYSTALS-Dilithium) Digital Signatures
topics.objective: Analyze Fiat-Shamir with aborts signature schemes and verify rejection sampling bounds.
topics.exercise: Generate and verify an ML-DSA-65 X.509 certificate chain, measuring signature and public key byte overheads.

topics.title: Constant-Time Polynomial Arithmetic & Side-Channel Mitigation
topics.objective: Prevent timing attacks and power analysis leakage in Number Theoretic Transform (NTT) multiplications.
topics.exercise: Audit an NTT polynomial multiplication routine to ensure zero branch divergences on secret key coefficient values.

topics.title: Hybrid Dual-Cert Cryptographic Migration Architecture
topics.objective: Architect enterprise migration roadmaps implementing hybrid classical-quantum cryptographic agility across PKI infrastructure.
topics.exercise: Draft an enterprise cryptographic agility policy supporting automated rollback if any PQC primitive discovers a cryptanalytic flaw.
